theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (N : Set (Euclid P)) (ξN : Euclid P → MultiVector P (n + 1)) (x : Euclid P) (ι : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid P) (u : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid P) (δ : ℝ), IsOrientation (n + 1) N ξN → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (n + 1), ξN x α = α (fun i => ι (EuclideanSpace.single i 1))) → 0 < δ → u 0 = 0 → fderiv ℝ u 0 = 0 → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 δ) → (∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid (n + 1)) δ, ∀ w : Euclid (n + 1), inner ℝ (ι w) (u v) = 0) → (∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid (n + 1)) δ, x + ι v + u v ∈ N) → ∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid (n + 1)) δ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (n + 1), ξN (x + ι v + u v) α * Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (n + 1) => inner ℝ (ι (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) + fderiv ℝ u v (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (ι (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) + fderiv ℝ u v (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)))) = α (fun i => ι (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) + fderiv ℝ u v (EuclideanSpace.single i 1))
